banglaExplanation: Strategy, স্থান, সময় আর cost ঠিক করার পর সব কিছু একটা planner-এ লিখে রাখতে হয়।
Planner দিয়ে strategy সাজানো যায়, আবার documentation আর record keeping-ও হয়।
CBLM-এর sample planner-এর তিনটা অংশ: Summary of the planner, Technical Competency Development Plan আর Certification।
Summary-তে দুই জায়গার approval-এর ঘর আছে: Principal আর Agency।
Plan অংশে প্রতিটা competency-র elements আর performance criteria লিখতে হয়; এগুলোই পরে evidence-এর ভিত্তি।

example.bn: CBLM-এর sample-ও একজন welding instructor-এর planner।
example.en: A welding Senior Instructor at a TTC fills the planner. He lists three welding units, the training centre, cost and months. His principal signs it.

rows: 1. Determine job specification and volume of work; 2. Identify cost elements and calculate costs; 3. Calculate total cost
1.1 Job specification and volume of work is identified. 2.1 Indirect costs are identified and calculated. 2.2 Direct costs are identified and calculated. 3.1 Total cost of work is calculated.
TRAWEL4016A1 Perform Shielded Metal Arc Welding (SMAW) - Positions 5G and 6G

1. Follow OSH practises; 2. Identify weld requirements from drawing; 3. Select and prepare materials; 4. Set up Job; 5. Set up welding equipment; 6. Perform Shielded Metal Arc Welding- Position 5G, 6G; 7. Clean and store equipment.

1.1 Safe work practices observed and PPE worn. 2.1 Weld requirements identified from work place drawing. 3.1-3.5 Materials selected, marked, cut, edges prepared, assembled and aligned. 4.1 Job is set up using a clamp. 5.1 Welding equipment is set up and adjusted. 6.1-6.3 Weld performed, cleaned and checked for quality. 7.1 Equipment is cleaned and stored.
TRAWEL4017A1 Perform Shielded Metal Arc Welding (SMAW) - Position 6GR
Same seven elements, with Position 6G and job set up at position (6GR).
Same performance criteria as TRAWEL4016A1; 4.1 Job is set up using a clamp at required position (6GR).

short.modelAnswer:
A planner is helpful for setting up strategies, documentation and record keeping. The sample planner has three parts:
1. Summary of the planner: trainer details, competency, NTVQ level, strategy, training centre, cost, time frame and approvals.
2. Technical Competency Development Plan: competency, elements and performance criteria.
3. Certification: an industry person certifies the units achieved.
